pins.command: r=$(node tools/checks-vendor.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*(symlinked member|replaced by a directory)'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 4 ]
pins.evidence:
FAIL drift: a declared member replaced by a directory is not a regular file
  FAIL drift: a symlinked member refuses even when its target holds the bundle's bytes
  ok drift: a symlinked member case restores clean
  FAIL freshness (--bundle) refuses a symlinked member whose target holds picasso's bytes

pins.command: r=$(node tools/checks-vendor.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*(no origin ref|non-origin remote)'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 2 ]
pins.evidence:
FAIL freshness refuses a pin on no origin ref (a local commit launders a patch)
  FAIL export refuses a HEAD that only a non-origin remote holds

pins.command: r=$(node tools/checks-vendor.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*(written through a link)'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 1 ]
pins.evidence: FAIL export refuses a member that would be written through a link, before writing anything

pins.command: r=$( { node tools/a11y-ratchet.mjs --self-test; node template/scripts/render-report.mjs --self-test; } 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*(another route|carries its route)'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 2 ]
pins.evidence:
FAIL the same violation on another route is a different defect
  FAIL every a11y entry carries its route (the ratchet's identity is route-scoped)

pins.command: ! grep -nF 'ROOT_SELECTOR=body REPORT_DIR=reports/ui' docs/WIRING.md && grep -qF 'ROOT_SELECTOR=<the app root' docs/WIRING.md
pins.evidence: 148:- run: BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> ROUTES="/, /feed, /watch" ROOT_SELECTOR=body REPORT_DIR=reports/ui node docs/gates/picasso/render-report.mjs

pins.command: r=$(node template/scripts/render-report.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*a second after load'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 3 ]
pins.evidence:
FAIL a console error a second after load is named
  FAIL a failing API call a second after load is named
  FAIL content mounted a second after load is audited

pins.command: r=$(node tools/size-budget.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*directory budget'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 2 ]
pins.evidence:
FAIL a directory budget sums every file beneath it
  FAIL a directory budget with no files is missing

pins.command: r=$(node tools/size-budget.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*not a green over nothing'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 3 ]
pins.evidence:
FAIL an empty budget list refuses with a rule, not a green over nothing
  FAIL a bare array refuses with a rule, not a green over nothing
  FAIL an object with no budgets refuses with a rule, not a green over nothing
